name: The Sphere Wellness Carnival
tagline: A celebration of wellness, connection and conscious living.
description: The Sphere Wellness Carnival — A celebration of wellness, connection and conscious living. 20 December 2026, 2:30 PM–10 PM, Jenney's Residency, Coimbatore.

payment_page._note: booking_api 'page' (26 November 2026, client request): the dialog sends guests to this Razorpay Payment Page with the ticket count filled in; Razorpay collects name, email and phone. Use the pages.razorpay.com address: the rzp.io short link drops the ticket count. quantity_param is Razorpay's name for the page's 'Ticket Cost' item; if the item is renamed in Razorpay, update it here or guests land on 1 ticket. booking_api 'on' goes back to one Razorpay link per booking through our server, reported to Meta.
payment_page._meta_note: Paid sales on this page are reported to Meta by the server (Razorpay webhook events payment.captured and order.paid). meta_sharing 'off': recorded, nothing sent. 'notice': the guest's hashed email, phone and name go to Meta for every sale; switch on only once the Razorpay page tells guests their details are shared with Meta. consent_field: the name of a tick-box field on the Razorpay page; when set, only guests who tick it are sent.

booking_dialog._note: Wording approved by the client on 2026-11-04. booking_api 'on' needs draft false.
booking_dialog.title: Book Your Experience
booking_dialog.consent_label: Spread the calm. We’d love to share this booking with Meta (Facebook and Instagram). It helps our adverts reach more women who’d enjoy The Sphere. You can leave this unticked.
booking_dialog.note: You will pay securely on Razorpay.
booking_dialog.error: We could not start your booking.

booking_confirmation._note: The page guests see after paying on Razorpay (/carnival/booked/). On 2026-11-21 the client asked us to write this wording in a professional tone; it adds no facts beyond the event details above. While draft is true, Razorpay does not send guests to this page.
booking_confirmation.title: Thank you
booking_confirmation.checking: One moment while we confirm your payment.
booking_confirmation.paid: Your booking is confirmed. We look forward to welcoming you to The Sphere Wellness Carnival.
booking_confirmation.pending: Razorpay is still confirming your payment. This can take a few minutes, so please do not pay again.
booking_confirmation.closed: This booking was not completed. You are welcome to book again from the Carnival page.
booking_confirmation.thanks: Thank you for booking The Sphere Wellness Carnival. We look forward to welcoming you.
